teaser: Three times in one week you say yes to something that isn't yours to fix, then spend the weekend turning it into a plan with deadlines. That is the 9 in you, reaching toward a good larger than yourself, and the ENTJ in you, who cannot leave a good cause unorganized. Life path 9 asks for release, for hands that open; the Commander in you keeps them closed around a strategy. The crossing here is not whether you care — you plainly do — but whether care can survive being run like an operation.
